cl.x: Provide SikaGrind®-272 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
SikaGrind®-272 is a chloride free, cement and slag liquid additive.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
s: Increase the strength development of cement
Improve the production rate of the cement and slag grinding system

cl.l: SikaGrind®-272 is a dispersant with the following characteristics:
s: Chemical activation of the hydration process (cement)
Neutralisation of electrical charges on the surface of the particles
Separation of the cement or slag particles

cl.l: SikaGrind®-272 provides the following advantages in the cement and slag production:
s: Enhanced grinding performance of the mill
Higher separator efficiency
Higher mill output (tons per hour)
Reduced relative power consumption per ton of material
Easier achievement of the desired binder fineness (Blaine, particle fraction > 45µm, grain size distribution)

cl.l: SikaGrind®-272 gives the following advantages to the finished cement:
s: Reduced quantity of “over-milled” particles in the binder grading
Increased strength development especially at early ages
Earlier set time characteristics
Economic cement design with clinker replacements
Composition: Aqueous solution of amino alcohols

cl.c: Data sheet pages 1-2: Product Information > Storage conditions
cl.x: Stored at temperatures between +5°C and +35°C. Protect from frost, direct sunlight and contamination. Note: When delivered in bulk, the tanks and equipment used must be free from contaminants. Material compatibility: Storage and transport in stainless steel or plastic containers (such as polyethylene (PE), polypropylene (PP), rigid PVC).
Refer to manufacturer. No separate substrate preparation section was identified in the data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02).
Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Information > Recommended dosage
cl.x: Typical dosage rates of SikaGrind®-272 are between 0.3 - 0.6 kg per ton of cement or slag (0.03% - 0.06% of total weight = cement clinker + additions or simply slag). The optimum dosage to achieve the desired characteristics shall be determined in plant trials. Influencing factors are e.g. the properties of clinker, type of cement, hardness of the slag and other plant variables. For consistent results, SikaGrind®-272 must be accurately dispensed (see the section Dispensing).

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Information > Dispensing
cl.x: SikaGrind®-272 shall be added onto the clinker feed shortly before the mill entrance or directly into the grinding mill (first or second compartment). Suitable dosage pumps with adjustable flow rates shall be used for accurate dosing. Note: Periodically, the end of the additive tube/hose shall be checked to ensure that it is not blocked.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Information > Compatibility
cl.x: Cements treated with SikaGrind®-272 are compatible in concretes produced with all commercial admixtures including air entrainers, water reducers, retarders and superplasticizers. The performance of concrete admixtures is not adversely affected by the use of SikaGrind®-272.
Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
